BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;SET LOCAL statement_timeout='8s';SET LOCAL lock_timeout='3s';
WITH pages AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT task_id,page_no,generation,provider,adapter_version,http_status,fetched_at,body_sha256,record_count,source_bytes,committed_at FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_pages_v2 WHERE run_id='fixed3000-20250901-20260731-v1-20261030' ORDER BY task_id,page_no LIMIT 15001),
joined AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT p.*,b.task_id IS NOT NULL has_readback,b.readback_sha256,b.actual_records,b.verified_at,b.task_id IS NOT NULL AND p.body_sha256=b.body_sha256 AND p.body_sha256=b.readback_sha256 AND p.record_count=b.expected_records AND p.record_count=b.actual_records matches FROM pages p LEFT JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_readbacks_v2 b ON b.task_id=p.task_id AND b.page_no=p.page_no),
agg AS(SELECT count(*) pages,count(*) FILTER(WHERE has_readback) readbacks,count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT has_readback) missing,count(*) FILTER(WHERE has_readback AND NOT matches) mismatches,max(committed_at) latest_commit,sum(record_count) records_or_pointers,sum(source_bytes) source_bytes,count(*) FILTER(WHERE committed_at>'2026-10-30T21:09:43.452059Z') post_v77_pages,count(*) FILTER(WHERE committed_at>'2026-10-30T21:09:43.452059Z' AND matches) post_v77_matches,count(*) FILTER(WHERE committed_at>'2026-10-30T21:09:43.452059Z' AND provider IN('Alpaca','Massive')) post_v77_provider_pages FROM joined),
sample AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM joined WHERE provider IN('Alpaca','Massive') ORDER BY committed_at DESC LIMIT 4)
SELECT clock_timestamp() observed_at,to_jsonb(agg) progress,agg.pages<15001 bounded_complete,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)||jsonb_build_object('family',t.family,'kind',t.kind,'current_task_source_revision',t.source_revision,'same_task_generation',t.generation=s.generation) ORDER BY s.committed_at DESC) FROM sample s JOIN astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_tasks_v2 t ON t.id=s.task_id) source_samples,
(SELECT jsonb_build_object('status',r.status,'fence',r.fence,'owner',r.metadata->>'implementation_owner','lease_until',r.metadata->>'implementation_lease_until','planning_complete',r.metadata->'planning_complete','planner_phase',r.metadata->'planner_phase','selection_cursor',r.metadata->'planner_next_selection_order','breadth_cursor',r.metadata->'planner_next_breadth_index','latest_audit_id',(SELECT max(id) FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_audit_v2 WHERE run_id=r.id),'recovery_audit_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_audit_v2 WHERE run_id=r.id AND evidence->>'request_id'='v78-same-controller-expired-lease-recovery-20261030T2218Z')) FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_runs_v2 r WHERE r.id='fixed3000-20250901-20260731-v1-20261030') ownership_planning,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(w)) FROM(SELECT worker_id,source_revision,capability_revision,observed_at FROM astra_ingestion_v1.backfill_workers_v2 ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 3)w) workers FROM agg;COMMIT;
